description: This file defines a service for aggregating hierarchical LLM (Large Language Model) costs from a MongoDB collection, including functions for data normalization, aggregation pipeline construction, and index management.

methods.name: projectionStage
methods.description: Creates a MongoDB projection stage to normalize and extract relevant fields from the llm_costs collection.

methods.name: addDateKeyStage
methods.description: Adds a date object to the pipeline, converting string dates to Date objects.

methods.name: projectDateKeyStage
methods.description: Projects fields including user, project, agent, tokens, cost, and formatted date string.

methods.name: groupByAgentDateStage
methods.description: Groups data by user, project, agent, and date, summing costs and tokens.

methods.name: groupAgentTotalsStage
methods.description: Aggregates agent data to compute total costs and organize costs and tokens by date.

methods.name: agentProjectStage
methods.description: Projects agent-level aggregation results with formatted costs and tokens.

methods.name: groupProjectStage
methods.description: Groups data by user and project, summing project costs and collecting agent data.

methods.name: groupUserStage
methods.description: Groups data by user, summing total user costs and collecting project data.

methods.name: finalProjectStage
methods.description: Projects final user-level aggregation with total cost and project details.

methods.name: aggregateHierarchy
methods.description: Main function to perform hierarchical aggregation of LLM costs, returning structured data with formatted costs and tokens.

methods.name: ensureLlmCostsIndexes
methods.description: Creates indexes on the llm-costs collection to optimize query performance.
